$comment: The pattern memory. The engine ships with these archetypes built in (src/archetypes.ts); this file is the canonical, human-editable catalogue and the growth point — add a new archetype + playbook here and register a matcher in src/archetypes.ts to teach the crawler a pattern once and reuse it on every later screen and every later run. Archetype equivalence: the Nth instance of a pattern gets the smoke playbook + a diff against the first, not the full battery.

archetypes.match: has input[type=password] and a submit; heading/url mentions sign in / log in
playbook: Password field is type=password (masked), not text.
A 'forgot password' path and a way to register are both reachable.
Empty submit is rejected with a clear message; wrong credentials show a non-leaky error.
Form posts over HTTPS; no credentials in the URL; rate-limited on repeated failure.

archetypes.match: password (+ confirm) present; heading/url mentions sign up / register / create account
playbook: Password + confirm match rule enforced; weak-password rule if the product claims one.
Duplicate email is rejected clearly (without leaking whether it existed, if that is the policy).
Every field has a visible label and an accessible name.

archetypes.match: text/url mentions forgot or reset password
playbook: Unknown email does NOT reveal whether an account exists (no user enumeration).
Success state tells the user to check their email; the token flow is single-use and expiring.

archetypes.match: a <form> with inputs and a submit, not a login
playbook: Every input has a visible label + accessible name.
Required fields validate on submit with the error NEAR the field, not only at the top.
Boundary + invalid input rejected; valid input persists after reload.
Header cells are <th>/scope'd; the empty state is handled.
Sort/paginate controls work and are keyboard reachable.
Numbers right-aligned + tabular; a total equals the sum of its rows.

archetypes.match: a list/table plus an Add/New/Create/Invite/Upload affordance
playbook: Create → the item appears in the list; edit persists; delete confirms and removes.
Empty state guides the user to create the first item.
Row actions are reachable and labelled.

archetypes.match: a search/filter input with a results area
playbook: Empty query handled; no-results state clear; results match the query; debounced, not janky.
Focus is trapped inside; Escape closes; focus returns to the trigger; the background is inert.
Back preserves entered data; refresh mid-flow does not lose state; each step validates before Next.

archetypes.match: fallback — a page that is none of the above
playbook: Renders without console errors; all links resolve; layout holds at every viewport.
